label: Appendix A
title: The bound on H(N)
text:
Equation (11) follows by counting organisations by depth. The Dirichlet series of the indicator of n ≥ 2 is ζ(s) − 1, and organisations of depth k are ordered k-fold products.

For Eq. (13) we follow Refs. [8, 9]. The bound holds at N = 1. If it holds below N, Eq. (10) gives

$$ H(N)\le\sum_{d\mid N,\,d>1}\left(\frac{N}{d}\right)^\rho<N^\rho\sum_{d\ge2}d^{-\rho}=N^\rho\bigl(\zeta(\rho)-1\bigr)=N^\rho. \tag{A1} $$
